# v0.24.6 — a summary circuit that counts rejections apart from failures and pauses instead of truncating, and images priced as the host prices them (#628, #627)

Qualified at the release candidate tag `v0.24.6-rc1` (`09383b2b`): this GA tree is that tree plus this file
(RELEASE-READINESS-V1; `git diff --name-status v0.24.6-rc1..v0.24.6` = only this file).

Patch release on top of `v0.24.5` (`19ed6341`). Runtime change: how the summary circuit counts, what a compaction does
while every summary route is refused, and how a structured image part is counted.
- No tool name or count, wire format, schema or privacy posture changed. `LCM plugin loaded` and every `lcm_*` name
  are unchanged. The only tool-visible change is the wording of the `survival_fit` advice in `/lcm doctor`.
- One new environment switch: `LCM_SUMMARY_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_REJECTION_THRESHOLD` (default `6`). The failure threshold
  (`LCM_SUMMARY_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_FAILURE_THRESHOLD`, default `2`) and the cooldown (default `300` s) are unchanged.
- Stored rows are never deleted or rewritten by any change below. Token estimates already stored for old rows are not
  recomputed.
- This release never moves a deployed pin by itself. A deployment moves only when its operator re-pins it.

## Changes since v0.24.5 (every change issue-first, reviewed at its exact head, receipted on its PR)

- **#628 (#630): a summary result the plugin rejects no longer switches model summaries off; and while every route is
  refused, compaction pauses instead of writing truncations.**
  - In the first nine hours of `v0.24.5` on 22 deployed profiles, one leaf with two rejected summary results opened the
    route's circuit on 3 profiles (4 events; 0 in the seven days before), and every later leaf of those compactions
    was stored as a level 3 truncation (512 tokens at most) for the 300-second cooldown. In one case all 12 leaves of
    a conversation's first compaction were truncations. No log line said why the results were rejected. Rows stayed
    stored and searchable; the working context was poorer than with a summary.
  - A result rejected for its content (empty, reasoning only, output contract violated, not shorter than its source) now
    has its own counter and threshold (`LCM_SUMMARY_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_REJECTION_THRESHOLD`, default 6). A call that
    raises or times out still counts toward the failure threshold (2). Every rejected result logs its reason; empty
    output gets its own line.
  - While the circuit refuses every summary route, a compaction that is not a forced overflow recovery writes no
    further leaf and no condensed node: it stops, keeps the rows for a later compaction, and re-checks the route before
    every condensation depth. A stop before the first leaf holds the threshold answer until a route is allowed again
    (1 to 600 seconds). The stop applies only when the survival fit can run (it is on and the model window is known);
    otherwise, and in a forced overflow recovery, the plugin converges through level 3 as before.
  - The compaction line counts the level 3 leaves it wrote; with none, the line is unchanged.
  - One departure from the issue: an empty response counts as a content rejection, not as a provider failure (the
    helper that calls the model returns the same value for empty, reasoning-only and contract-violating output, and
    integrations patch that helper).
- **#627 (#639): a structured image part is priced at the host's per-image cost instead of by its characters.**
  - A tool result holding one inline image of 0.5 MB counted about 130,000 tokens; the host and the provider price an
    image at a flat figure (the host's default is 1,500). The over-count made the plugin compact when the host had not
    asked, cut the protected tail to one or two rows, and could start the forced overflow recovery.
  - `count_message_tokens` now prices image parts flat, by the shape of the message content: a list with parts of type
    `image`, `image_url` or `input_image` counts the JSON of the list with each such part replaced by a placeholder,
    plus one image price per part; a `_multimodal` tool result with image parts counts its `text_summary` plus one
    price per part. The price is the host's `current_image_token_cost()` when the host module imports and returns a
    positive integer, else 1,500. Strings, JSON strings included, and content without image parts count exactly as
    before. A part whose `type` is not a string is no image part and never raises.
  - Not changed: image blocks in `_anthropic_content_blocks`, the stub decision for large tool outputs, audio and file
    payloads, and the estimates already stored for old rows.
- **#620 (#623, #641): the rollback advice after a survival fit is complete and names its target.**
  - `/lcm doctor` and the operator guide no longer call a plugin-only rollback within 0.24.x supported after a survival
    fit that dropped turns without a projection; every store with a survival fit gets the backup restore, and a stored
    count that cannot be read is treated as a fit (#623).
  - The advice names its target: the backup restore applies to a rollback to a 0.24.x version older than `v0.24.5`; a
    rollback of the plugin alone to `v0.24.5` or later is fine, because `v0.24.5` already knows survival fits. The texts
    name the configured database file (by default `lcm.db`, with its `-wal` and `-shm` companions) instead of the
    literal file name (#641).
  - The skill reference documents the summary-circuit keys and what a refused route means after #628; the `v0.24.5`
    CHANGELOG header carries its release date.
- **#618: a failed survival-fit counter write is logged at WARNING instead of DEBUG**, so the operator guide's second
  rollback check (no `LCM survival fit applied` line, no failed counter write) can be established from the logs.
- **Docs and tests:** the exception of the #600 fix counts rows an earlier summary already covers toward the 8,000
  owned rows (#621); the #608 tests no longer depend on which token counter is importable (#615).

## Known follow-ups and limitations (tracked)

- #640 — after a host cancels a turn once a leaf is committed, a retry that replays the run while every summary route
  is refused adopts the committed summary only on the first compaction after the cooldown (a delay of at most 300 s; no
  row lost or stored twice).
- #618 — the hold after a zero-leaf stop is kept per engine, not per conversation, and uses the wall clock; the
  compaction line does not yet print both token counts.
- Rollup builds are unchanged: with every route refused they still store a level 3 cut; their rejections count toward
  the new threshold.
- A tiny structured image part (a short URL) now counts about one image price more than before, because the host prices
  it the same way. Image data inside a plain string still counts as text.
- Why the silent rejections of `v0.24.5` happened is not known yet; the new reason lines will show it in the field.
- #615 — token counts with `tiktoken` installed differ from the fallback counter in a known set of tests.
- #597, #626 — a large hidden backlog drains one bounded leaf per at-threshold pass, and a compaction that runs on
  every turn until the backlog is drained; both target v0.24.7.
- Host message identity (`message_uid`, upstream Hermes) is the next feature release, v0.25.0; it does not change this
  release.
- #485, #542, #588, #592, #593, #541, #569, #574, the #509 native family, the #501 class, the whole-session row-mapper
  scan, #538, #531, #532, #534, #540, #545, #506, #507 — unchanged from `v0.24.5`.
- After a drop-only survival fit, restarting the store (a fresh bind, or an older plugin version reopening it) re-stores the fitted-tail rows as duplicates; duplicates only, no loss and no conflict. This is present in v0.24.5 and is tracked in #644, the drop-only sibling of #601, #606 and #607.
- When the summary circuit is open, `lcm doctor` and `lcm_status` both report the compaction stop as `summary_route_unavailable`; the stored rows are kept and the route is re-checked on the next pass (#628).

## Benchmark boundary

No benchmark or scoring path changed. Token counting changed only for a message that holds a structured image part;
summarization prompts, recall and the doctor scans are unchanged except for the wording of one advice. `v0.24.4`
numbers stand.

## Upgrade

- **Install:** `hermes plugins install https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x --force --ref <this tag's sha>` for a pinned
  install (`hermes plugins update hermes-lcm-x` re-pins catalog installs only).
- **Config:** nothing to change. `LCM_SUMMARY_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_REJECTION_THRESHOLD` is optional (default 6). A
  `LCM_RESERVE_TOKENS_FLOOR` that was raised or lowered to absorb image over-counts can return to its intended value.
  The schema version stays 5. Upgrading from v0.23.x (`hermes-lcm`): do the v0.24.0 migration first (README,
  "Migrating from hermes-lcm").
- **Rollback to v0.24.5** is a plugin reinstall; the store needs no restore (`v0.24.5` knows survival fits). Rollback is
  measured at this tag (Phase B hands-on) and reported in the GA notes.
- **Native recovery:** hosts without the #479 host fix (older than `v2026.9.24`) run `LCM_NATIVE_RECOVERY=false`, as
  before.
